notes.title: 👑 Queens Climax Launch Day 👑
notes.notes:
Greetings from AGL studios!
We’ve been hard at work! Thank you for your patience and support during the long wait.

Queens Climax is a beautiful or cruel 2D erotic visual novel where a kidnapped and enslaved princess, is thrown into a kingdom of darkness. Win the hearts of your enemies through seduction and escape or descend into the twisted grasp of your captor, Queen Renea!
